content: Android 14+ requires declaring an explicit foreground service TYPE for every FGS or the system throws MissingForegroundServiceTypeException; 'shortService' and 'systemExempted' types don't need a separate Play Console declaration but shortService is capped at ~3 minutes runtime. This app's 'no persistent foreground service' design sidesteps the whole FGS-type minefield; any future feature needing a real FGS reopens this requirement.
